description: This PHP file contains a test case class 'BeanFactoryTestCase' used for testing module beans and their extensions within the SuiteCRM framework. It includes setup and teardown methods, module configuration providers, and functions to manage core module extensions, as well as to compile include extension files.
external_methods: File functions: file_exists, file_get_contents, file_put_contents, unlink, mkdir_recursive

classes.name: SuiteCRM\Test\BeanFactoryTestCase
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class designed for testing bean factory functionality and module extensions in SuiteCRM. It manages setup and teardown procedures, module configuration, and extension management.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by removing all core module extensions before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after each test by removing all extensions and refreshing module globals.

methods.name: moduleConfigProvider
methods.description: Provides configuration data for modules based on current global variables and test settings.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of modules to be tested, either all or a specific module based on settings.

methods.name: shouldSkipModule
methods.description: Determines whether a module should be skipped from tests based on file existence and bean properties.

methods.name: compileIncludeExtFiles
methods.description: Compiles extension include files into a single PHP file for performance optimization.

methods.name: shouldSkipFileEntry
methods.description: Checks if a file should be skipped based on its name and type (not PHP or directory).

methods.name: addCoreModuleExtension
methods.description: Creates and writes extension files for a specific module, allowing for custom class overrides.

methods.name: removeCoreModuleExtension
methods.description: Removes extension files for a specific module, cleaning up custom class overrides.

methods.name: removeCoreModuleAllExtension
methods.description: Removes all extension files for all modules defined in module configuration.

methods.name: refreshModuleGlobals
methods.description: Refreshes global variables related to modules and beans to ensure consistency.
